summary: close the A0003 residuals and align the threat model and the strategy contract with the research layer
owner_direction:
Owner direction for the A0004 SPEC amendment (2026-09-19).

CONTEXT. A0003 aligned the Web console specification and eight planned contracts with
ADR-014 (research universe, numeraire hierarchy, model boundary) and ADR-015 (per-pool
extended-history window). A0003 deliberately left two things undone and this amendment
closes them, plus the two remaining planned contracts that still carry pre-redesign
wording. Do not edit docs/intent/ and do not reopen an accepted ADR: cite them.

1. docs/spec/product/WEB_CONSOLE.md, section 4 (visualisation minimum).

   The existing clause that a position chart must show USDG-equivalent value is
   unconditional, while WEB-GLOBAL-001 as amended now requires a RELATIVE_ONLY
   dataset to carry no USD-denominated field anywhere. As written the specification
   contains two clauses that cannot both be satisfied for such a dataset. Make the
   position-chart clause conditional: it must show raw token quantities always, and
   the reporting-numeraire equivalent when the dataset is QUALIFIED, and must show the
   relative form and an explicit RELATIVE_ONLY marker when it is not. Do not weaken
   any other clause in section 4, and do not touch sections 5 or 6.

2. docs/spec/security/THREAT_MODEL.md.

   Add threat rows for the research layer. The document's own update procedure requires
   a new threat to carry a severity and an owner, so follow the existing row format and
   numbering rather than inventing a new shape. At minimum cover:
   (a) label leakage or look-ahead in the research panel producing a model that appears
       predictive and is not, with the purge/embargo rule from
       research/DATASET_AND_EVALUATION.md DS-022 as the control;
   (b) a RELATIVE_ONLY research artifact being read, reported or promoted as a
       USD-denominated result;
   (c) a research artifact or model acquiring execution authority, appearing as an
       approval, or becoming the live default;
   (d) model output bypassing or weakening the central risk gateway;
   (e) a dataset version, numeraire or split boundary being mutated after publication,
       so a published result can no longer be reproduced.
   State for each row what the existing controls are and which task owns them. Do not
   restate or weaken any existing threat row, and do not change the trust boundaries
   or the document's structure.

3. Two contract edits, body text only. Each target keeps its identity, status, attempt
   and dependency fields.

 - T086: extend the journeys and acceptance so that the console's research pages are
   not reachable from, and cannot be confused with, an execution-shaped control, and
   so that a RELATIVE_ONLY dataset is visibly distinguishable in every journey that
   displays a result. Do not add a journey for the four pages owned by T103; those are
   validated by that task.
 - T060: record that the regime and fee-opportunity components are the sole supported
   extension point for a trained model, that a model-backed implementation must satisfy
   the same contract as a rule implementation and may not alter the snapshot, the
   candidate action, the ledger, risk or audit semantics, and that the interface must
   be able to signal uncertainty and refuse to produce an assessment rather than force
   one. Align the component and output naming with
   docs/spec/strategy/STRATEGY_ECONOMICS.md section 7 so the specification and the
   contract use one vocabulary; state explicitly which name denotes the component and
   which denotes its output. Do not change any existing acceptance clause.

4. Raise spec_revision.

5. CONSTRAINTS. Change only docs/spec/product/WEB_CONSOLE.md,
   docs/spec/security/THREAT_MODEL.md, the two named contracts, and spec_revision. Do
   not edit docs/intent/. Do not edit any other contract. Do not change any task
   status, attempt, evidence pointer, commit SHA, review record, approval datum or the
   agent runtime. Do not cite the superseded T022, T023 or T038 as live governing
   contracts. No credential-bearing URL, API key, authorization header or environment
   value may be written into any file.
